name: Grid
description: Grid is a polymorphic, responsive 2‑D layout primitive built on Box. It exposes a CSS‑variable API for track templates, auto‑placement, alignment, and per‑axis gaps - great for card grids, dashboards, and complex layouts.

props.name: as
props.description: Polymorphic prop to change the rendered element type

props.name: columns
props.description: Column track template or count (e.g. "repeat(12, 1fr)" or 12); supports responsive values

props.name: rows
props.description: Row track template or count (e.g. "auto 1fr auto" or 3); supports responsive values

props.name: autoRows
props.description: Size for implicitly created rows (grid-auto-rows); responsive

props.name: autoColumns
props.description: Size for implicitly created columns (grid-auto-columns); responsive

props.name: placeItems
props.description: Shorthand alignment for items within their cells (place-items); responsive

props.name: placeContent
props.description: Shorthand alignment for the grid within its container (place-content); responsive

props.name: gap
props.description: Shorthand gap between grid items; accepts scale tokens or raw CSS; responsive

props.name: rowGap
props.description: Vertical spacing between rows; overrides gap on the block axis; responsive

props.name: columnGap
props.description: Horizontal spacing between columns; overrides gap on the inline axis; responsive
